steps.title: Bring to room temperature
steps.body: Make sure butter, cream cheese and eggs are at room temperature.

steps.title: Cream butter and cheese
steps.body: Cream together: **3 cubes of butter (no margarine)** and **1 brick (8 ounces) cream cheese, original**.

steps.title: Add sugar and vanilla
steps.body: Add: **3 cups sugar** and **1½ tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Add eggs and flour
steps.body: Alternate adding: **6 eggs** (2 at a time) and **3 cups flour** (1 at a time).

steps.title: Pour into pan
steps.body: Pour batter into a buttered and sugared Bundt pan. DO NOT PREHEAT THE OVEN.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place cake in a cold oven and set to 325°F. Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes. Cook until set. I cook an additional 3 minutes at a time.
